name: Joseph Cardinale
bottom_line: His 2024 campaign site, largely unchanged: its dated posts and footer are from 2024. His NYPD background checks out. The page and his 2026 profile give different family details.
findings: Retired NYPD lieutenant commander and owner of Blue Line Pilot Cars match press and Branch profiles.
The site says he is a father of three daughters; Branch's 2026 profile lists four children.
page_issues: Dated posts (Oct–Nov 2024) and a 2024 footer; no 2026-specific content.
